criteria.label: UI/UX
criteria.description: How the project looks and how intuitive it is; whether visuals help.

criteria.label: Creativity
criteria.description: How unique and innovative the approach is.

criteria.label: Feasibility
criteria.description: How likely it is to exist in the real world, and whether its costs are worth the benefits.

criteria.label: Functionality
criteria.description: How well it works, including outside the local environment.

criteria.label: Impact
criteria.description: How much difference it makes and how efficiently it solves the problem.

judging.judge_profile_summary: Judges were listed as TBD on the event page.
judging.notes: Each criterion is scored out of 10, for a total out of 50.

sources.note: Dates, location, participants, prizes, judging criteria and scoring.
All 10 pages captured: 231 of 231 submissions; prize names from each of the 22 winning project pages.

curator_notes: All 22 prize winners are analyzed records. The overall top three are ranked. Five criteria are scored equally out of 10 each, recorded as weights of 20. Feasibility includes cost versus benefit, so it maps to cost-sustainability. A Flash CTF prize has no winning project page. Taglines are CrafterWIKI paraphrases; domains assigned conservatively.
